# Blog

Published Entire blog posts in Changelog, newest first.

- [Push during Upstream Downtimes with Entire-Native Branches](ORIGIN/blog/entire-dispatch-0x001d.md) (2026-09-09): Entire-native branches let you keep pushing while your upstream is down, plus fixes to packfile reads, reclaimed mirror names, incremental repository maintenance, git-sync clone resumes, a go-git credential leak, and binary files in the file viewer.
- [Introducing Agentic Search for Code and Context](ORIGIN/blog/introducing-agentic-search-for-code-and-context.md) (2026-09-03): A faster way for agents to understand what changed and why.
- [Entire Now Tracks Your Subagent Activity](ORIGIN/blog/entire-dispatch-0x001c.md) (2026-08-31): Subagent work is now saved in checkpoints for Claude Code and Factory Droid, with limited support for Codex and Cursor. A second secret-scanning engine makes redaction faster on long sessions.
- [Set Up Entire Without Hunting for the Next Command](ORIGIN/blog/entire-dispatch-0x001b.md) (2026-08-24): A new getting started flow guides you through installing the Entire CLI, logging in, enabling checkpoints, and creating your first checkpoint. Checkpoints also follow the remote you push to.
